--></big><noinclude>This template is used to show questions with hidden answers in the [[Lojban by Choice]] wikibook. It is used like this:

<pre>{{SbcQuestion
| <question1> | <answer1>
| <question2> | <answer2>
...
| <question20> | <answer20>
}}</pre>

While you can specify less than 20 question answer pairs, it is not possible to specify more than 20 pairs. This template is usually used together with [[Template:SbcQuestionPrint]] for the print version.
